items.author: Priya Sharma
items.raw: Tracked down why some EU customers were seeing prices in USD instead of their local currency — the geo-IP lookup service was timing out silently and we defaulted to USD on any error instead of the customer's account-level currency preference. Fixed the fallback to use account currency, not a hardcoded default.

items.author: Priya Sharma
items.raw: Following up on the refund escalation — spoke with the customer directly, Arjun Mehta, reachable at arjun.mehta@gmail.com or +91 98765 43210, and confirmed the double-charge was from the split-payment tax bug (PAY-915). Manually refunded the duplicate ₹1,240 charge and let him know it's resolved.

items.author: Priya Sharma
items.raw: Ticket PAY-922: Escalated by support lead Neha Kulkarni (neha.kulkarni@company.com) — a vendor payout was sent to a stale bank account on file because our account-update webhook from the banking partner wasn't being processed, just logged and ignored. Fixed by actually consuming the webhook and updating the payout record. Confirmed fix with Neha before closing.

items.author: Priya Sharma
items.raw: Ticket PAY-915: Split-payment orders (part gift card, part credit card) were double-counting the gift card portion in the tax calculation because tax was computed on the pre-split total and then again on the credit-card sub-total. Fixed by computing tax once on the full order total before splitting. Resolved.
